subject.title: [Feature]: Separate internal testing helpers from Plugin SDK agent-runtime

question: Which released `testing` and `__testing` members should remain supported for external plugins, and what replacement entrypoint and deprecation window should become the permanent Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The mechanical refactor depends on a compatibility-policy choice: repository inspection can find consumers, but it cannot decide which historically exported testing helpers OpenClaw intends to support long term.

options.title: Narrow Additive Contract
options.body: Inventory shipped consumers, add one explicit minimal testing contract, migrate bundled callers, and retain deprecated aliases only for the documented compatibility window.

options.title: Freeze Existing Shape
options.body: Keep the current testing object shape as a deprecated compatibility contract and only block future field growth until a later major SDK cleanup.

options.title: Fold Into SDK Program
options.body: Move implementation under the broader SDK-consolidation program and keep this issue as its concrete acceptance criterion rather than landing a standalone migration.

recommendation.title: Narrow Additive Contract
recommendation.body: Inventory shipped consumers, add one explicit minimal testing contract, migrate bundled callers, and retain deprecated aliases only for the documented compatibility window.

likelyOwner.reason: They framed the exact compatibility boundary and are the strongest available owner for deciding the intended supported helper set.
